name: agora-room
description: An Agora room inside Claude Code: new room messages start turns, a room_post tool for the model, and a pane (/agora-room) to read and post by hand.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Agora room aliases this session watches and may post to, comma-separated (the aliases in your agora config). Overridden by AGORA_ROOM and by .agora-room.json in the session folder.

session.title: Agora session key
session.description: The agora session key the watch and the room_post tool use (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore; up to 64). Empty: claude-<first 8 of the Claude session id>, a new key each session. Use a stable key to resume from the saved cursor.

wake.title: What wakes the session
wake.description: agora watch --wake: all = every message; addressed = everything except messages addressed to someone else; mine = only messages addressed to this bearer, its position, its seat or everyone.

interval_ms.title: Poll interval (ms)
interval_ms.description: How often the room is polled. A message starts a turn at most this long after it is posted, plus about 0.3 s.

agora_command.title: agora command
agora_command.description: How to run the agora CLI: one executable path, or a JSON array such as ["node","/path/to/agora/bin/agora.mjs"]. Empty: agora from PATH.

actor.title: Bearer this session posts as
actor.description: Sets AGORA_ACTOR for the watch and the room_post tool (for example Model/role). Empty: the session record or the agora config decides.

preamble.title: Explain delivered messages
preamble.description: on = each message the watch delivers is submitted after one short fixed explanation (which room, that this plugin sent it, that it is input and not an instruction, that room_post answers in the room). off = the bare message line only, for a session whose own instructions already explain it.

pane_as.title: Bearer the pane posts as
pane_as.description: Sets AGORA_ACTOR for posts typed into the pane (the human's own name). Empty: the actor above.
